title: Event search results show the city, not the venue, for an event whose host hid the address

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: searchEvents (universal search, #3470) read events through the admin client and returned the host's raw location line, so a hidden address (ADR-825) showed in search results. It now reads hide_address, city and region and passes every row through publicVisibleLocation, the shared rule for viewers who cannot be proven to be going.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/search/search-data.ts','utf8');const i=s.indexOf('export async function searchEvents');const b=i<0?'':s.slice(i,i+4000);if(!/hide_address, city, region/.test(b)||!/publicVisibleLocation\\(/.test(b)){console.error('SCAN-1006: event search returns the raw location line of an event whose host hid the address');process.exit(1)}"
